text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #777777

g.text: Tick to order out: from a quote, decoded, to its order at the broker's thread; reading IB's socket and writing the order to it are not in it. The broker is a stand-in that fills at once.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #777777

g.text: Each number the median of three runs (scripts/bench.sh). In the bar, tinted: the engine at work; dotted: waiting for the next thread.
